industry_blueprint.decision_path: 使用者场景→结构材料→安全→包装→定制
industry_blueprint.red_lines: 不编年龄安全、承重、无毒或法规达标；玩具与运动用品分别核实用途
industry_blueprint.missing_data_fallback: 先拆分具体品类，收集测试与用途，再决定可公开字段

visual_archetype.palette_direction: Editorial high-contrast neutral canvas with bespoke brand-extracted accent token
visual_archetype.typography_pairing: Syne / General Sans (headings) + Plus Jakarta Sans (body) + JetBrains Mono (GSM/oz, MOQ, carton specs)
signature_components: First-viewport interactive OEM customization configurator (material, logo craft, packaging)

gefei_b2b_competitor_teardown.domain_to_keyword: Extract top organic landing pages and inquiry keywords from 3-5 overseas B2B niche manufacturers/importers.
gefei_b2b_competitor_teardown.keyword_to_domain: Inspect live SERP top 10 for each branch; confirm at least 60% are B2B supplier/spec pages rather than B2C retail listings, and check for inner-page rankings or DR < 30 weak spots.
gefei_b2b_competitor_teardown.multilingual_rule: Never machine-translate keywords across languages; re-research native industrial nomenclature (e.g., DIN/EN for DE, ASTM for US, JIS for JA) per target market.
